content:
**Monongahela National Forest** is a location in Appalachia.

The national forest was a vast pre-War recreational area in what would eventually become the Savage Divide. The area encompassed Spruce Knob Lake and Campground as well as the Dolly Sods Campground and Dolly Sods Wilderness.

Monongahela National Forest was a large national forest within the Appalachian wilderness. The park consisted of recreational and campground areas.

Monongahela National Forest appears in *Fallout 76*.

The location is based on the real world Monongahela National Forest, situated in the Allegheny Mountains of eastern West Virginia.
